dict.string: ARES listens for "Hey ARES" and your voice commands.
ARES controls apps like Music, Reminders and Notes when you ask her to.
ARES transcribes your voice on this Mac to understand commands. Audio never leaves your Mac.
ARES watches for hand gestures while you're at your desk (only when Hand Gestures is on). Video stays on this Mac in the camera helper; only hand positions reach ARES, and nothing is recorded.
